mapper.select: SELECT 'scm.merge.salesOrder' AS label_key, COUNT(*) AS total, 0 AS conflicts FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'SALES' AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.salesTradeDoc', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.tradeDraft', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind IN ('SALES_OUT', 'SALES_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.quotation', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_quotation WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.delivery', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_delivery WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.shipment', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_shipment WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.rebate', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_rebate WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.channelReport', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_channel_report WHERE customer_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.priceList', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_price_list WHERE customer_id IN

SELECT 'scm.merge.purchaseOrder' AS label_key, COUNT(*) AS total, 0 AS conflicts FROM scm_order WHERE kind = 'PURCHASE' AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.purchaseTradeDoc', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.tradeDraft', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE kind IN ('PURCHASE_IN', 'PURCHASE_RETURN') AND partner_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.carrier', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_doc WHERE carrier_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.carrier', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_trade_draft WHERE carrier_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.carrier', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_shipment WHERE carrier_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.requisition', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_requisition_item WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.inquiry', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_inquiry_supplier WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.inquiryQuote', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_inquiry_quote WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.supplierEval', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_supplier_eval WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.rebate', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_rebate WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.purchaseContract', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_purchase_contract WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.tender', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_tender WHERE award_supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.tender', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_tender_supplier WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.bid', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_bid WHERE supplier_id IN UNION ALL SELECT 'scm.merge.asn', COUNT(*), 0 FROM scm_asn WHERE supplier_id IN

mapper.select: SELECT i.inquiry_no FROM scm_inquiry_supplier s JOIN scm_inquiry i ON i.id = s.inquiry_id WHERE s.supplier_id IN GROUP BY i.id, i.inquiry_no HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY i.id

SELECT t.tender_no FROM ( SELECT tender_id, supplier_id FROM scm_tender_supplier WHERE supplier_id IN UNION SELECT tender_id, supplier_id FROM scm_bid WHERE supplier_id IN ) x JOIN scm_tender t ON t.id = x.tender_id GROUP BY t.id, t.tender_no HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT x.supplier_id) > 1 ORDER BY t.id
SELECT period FROM scm_channel_report WHERE customer_id IN GROUP BY period HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY period
